name: Courtyard Residence
tagline: Two single-storey modules form an L around a sheltered garden courtyard, with rooms opening in several directions.
description: A long 40-foot module and a perpendicular 40-foot module enclose a private courtyard. Living, dining, kitchen, bathroom, bedroom and workspace open onto the courtyard and the surrounding woodland. The footprint is larger than the cottage, but the home remains single-storey and step-free. A flat green roof is shown as a concept only, with unresolved drainage and load questions.

architecture.intent: Single-storey L-shaped courtyard home with multiple orientations.

roof_form.maintenance: Plant, drain and roof access need a maintenance plan.
roof_form.note: Roof geometry is conceptual and independent of the container geometry. It does not create an occupied storey.
